question: Who among the following is one of the authors of ‘The Hitman: The Rohit Sharma Story’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**G Krishnan**__.

__
 
• **G Krishnan **is one of the authors of** The Hitman**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Hit Man** book is based on one of the cricket players **Rohit Sharma.**
 
• **Rohit Sharma** is an** Indian international cricketer **who **captains **the** India national cricket team** in **ODIs** and **T20Is**. He **vice-captains **the** Indian cricket team **in **Test cricket.**
 
• **Sharma** made his **List A **debut for **West Zone **against **Central Zone **in the** Deodhar Trophy **at **Gwalior **in **March 2005.**
 
• In **November 2013,** during **Sachin Tendulkar's farewell series**, Sharma made his **Test debut **at **Eden Gardens** in **Kolkata** against the **West Indies.**
 
• In **November 2020**, Sharma was nominated for the** ICC Men's ODI **and** T20I Cricketer **of the **Decade awards.**
